AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Dart}Magic Bolt
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Hurl a magical bolt at the enemy. The missile homes in on the target and does 40 damage in a 3 meter radius on contact.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_WardOfArrows}Ward of Arrows
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster is immune to ranged damage for 15 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_MinorHeal}Petty Heal
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Heals the caster for 3 health every second for 7 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_FoetidCloud}Foetid Cloud
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A sickly short ranged poisonous gas cloud does 30 magic damage in a 3 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_EnchantWeapon}Enchant Weapon
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Buff a target ally's weapon to do 10% additional magic damage for 20 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_AuraOfResistance}Aura of Resistance
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Allies in a 3 meter radius gain 20% physical resistance for 15 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_StrengthOfCombat}Strength Of Combat
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Adds 20% physical damage bonus for 15 seconds to the caster.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_DustStorm}Dust Storm
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Dry winds from the desert knock down victims and apply minor damage (5 per second in a 3 meter radius).

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Fireball}Fireball
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Hurl a fireball dealing 60 damage in a 4 meter radius and burning foes for 5 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_CinderBlast}Cinder Blast
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Hurl fragments of solidified lava that deal 55 damage on contact in a 3 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_BoltOfAqshy}Bolt of Aqshy
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A fast moving flaming bolt that does 60 fire damage on impact in a 2 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Sear}Sear
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Blast the enemy with a short-ranged searing flame that does 65 fire damage in a 6 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_CascadingFireCloak}Cascading Fire-Cloak
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Wreath the caster in flame, granting 20% physical and 70% fire resistance for 30 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_FlamingSwords}Flaming Sword of Rhuin
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Buff the weapons of allies in a 5 meter radius with flame, adding 15% fire damage for 45 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_BurningHead}The Burning Head
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Conjure a large burning skull that moves forward, burning everything in its path (40 fire damage per second).

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_FlameStorm}Fire Tornado
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Summon a randomly moving pillar of searing flame that burns the battlefield (40 fire damage per second).

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_LightningBolt}Lightning Bolt
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Hurl an electric bolt at the enemy that does 65 lightning damage on impact in a 2.5 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_WindBlast}Wind Blast
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A gust of wind knocks down victims and applies 35 physical damage in a 15 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_ChainLightning}Chain Lightning
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A ball of lightning that drifts across the field, zapping enemies in its area for 45 lightning damage per tick.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_HarmonicConvergence}Harmonic Convergence
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Divine favourable signs guide your warriors: allies in a 5 meter radius gain 50% physical resistance for 50 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Blizzard}Iceshard Blizzard
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Stormy clouds loom over the area, showering those below with sharp shards of ice (35 damage per tick in a 3 meter radius).

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_CometOfCasandora}Comet of Casandora
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A large meteor strikes the area, killing all below in a giant shockwave (225 magic damage in a 15 meter radius).

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Thunderbolt}Urannon's Thunderbolt
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A single large bolt of lightning crashes down from the skies for 120 lightning damage in a 5 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_CurseOfMidnightWind}Curse of the Midnight Wind
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: An ancient three-word hex curses enemies in a 5 meter radius, imposing a 40% penalty to movement, attack speed, and damage resistance for 30 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_ShemGaze}Shem's Burning Gaze
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A bolt of cleansing energy flies from the caster's hands, searing evil for 55 holy damage in a 2 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_HealingLight}Healing Light
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Allies in a 3 meter radius regenerate 5 health every second for 9 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_PhaProtection}Pha's Protection
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The Guardian of Light protects your allies: those in a 5 meter radius gain 50% physical resistance for 50 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_DeathlyShards}Deathly Shards
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Sharp shards of light fly at the target, piercing the toughest armour for 120 holy damage in a 3 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_RadiancePillar}Pillar of Radiance
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A towering pillar of light scours the area, dealing 40 holy damage per tick in a 3 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_RadiantGaze}Radiant Gaze
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A Hysh-infused wave of deadly energy rolls forward, dealing 35 holy damage per tick to enemies in its path.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_NetOfAmyntok}Net of Amyntok
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: An arcane net snares foes in a 5 meter radius, halting them in place for 25 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_BironasTimewarp}Birona's Timewarp
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Warps the flow of time around you: you and allies within 15 meters gain 40% movement, attack, and reload speed for 15 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_TasteOfDeath}Taste of Death
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A skeletal hand reaches for the target, snuffing out their life in a heartbeat: 101 magic damage in a shockwave.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_AshesAndDust}Ashes and Dust
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster looses potent death magic upon the foe, leaving nothing but dust: 60 magic damage in a 5 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_PurpleSun}Purple Sun of Xereus
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A vicious whirlwind of pure death drifts across the field, tearing at the life energies of all it touches (75 magic damage per tick).

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_FateOfBjuna}Fate of Bjuna
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Enemies in a 10 meter radius are cursed with eternal laughter, taking magic damage and moving at half speed for 15 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Amaranth}Amaranth
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The spirits of the damned form a barrier against magic: you and allies within 20 meters lose 50% of incoming spell potency for 20 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_SpiritLeech}Spirit Leech
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster drains the life force from foes in a 7.5 meter radius, withering their flesh with potent magic damage over time.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_CaressOfLaniph}Caress of Laniph
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A purple mist surrounds enemies in a 7.5 meter radius, gently draining their life (armour-ignoring magic damage over 10 seconds).

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_DwellersBelow}Dwellers Below
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Tendrils emerge from the ground, reaching out and attacking enemies in the area. Knocks down and slows (80%) enemies while dealing 10 damage per second for 15 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_TheGreenEye}The Green Eye
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster merges their eyes into one, loosing a single fast bolt of pure life-magic that strikes for 50 damage in a 4 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Barkskin}Barkskin
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster hardens the skin of nearby allies like ancient bark, granting 50% physical resistance for 80 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_SummerHeat}Summer Heat
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A small area radiates unbearable heat, impairing enemy movement by 50% and leaving them vulnerable to fire for 15 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Regrowth}Regrowth
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Invoking the lord of the ancient wildshrines, the caster mends wounds. Allies in a 3 meter radius gain 5 HP per second for 12 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_DrainLife}Drain Life
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster sucks the moisture and fluids from foes in a 3 meter radius, dealing 5 magic damage per second for 10 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_StormOfRenewal}Storm of Renewal
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Raw energy flows across the battlefield, renewing lost vigour. Heals allies for 30 hitpoints instantly, then 10 HP per second for 12 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_ShieldOfThorns}Shield of Thorns
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Prickly gorse wreathes allies in a 3 meter radius, reflecting 25% of incoming melee damage back at attackers for 80 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_AmberSpear}Amber Spear
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster hurls a javelin of hardened amber that flies through everything in its path, dealing 60 damage to each enemy it pierces (double on a headshot) before sticking in the ground.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_AmberSpearThrown}Amber Spear
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster conjures a real amber javelin and hurls it — piercing shields and enemies, scaling with both Throwing and Spellcraft.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_TanglingThorn}Tangling Thorn
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Roots erupt from the ground, entangling and halting all enemies in the area for 10 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_PannsImpenetrablePelt}Pann's Impenetrable Pelt
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A magical hide wreathes the caster, granting 40% physical resistance for 40 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_HailStorm}Hail Storm
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A storm of jagged stones crashes down on the foe, dealing 35 physical damage per tick in a 3 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_FlockOfDoom}Flock of Doom
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Summons a nightmare of crows over the targeted area. Enemies caught within take damage over time and have their physical resistance reduced by 20% for 10 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_TheBeastUnleashed}The Beast Unleashed
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Unleashes the primal savagery of nearby allies, granting +25% physical damage and attack speed for 60 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_CurseOfAnraheir}Curse of Anraheir
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Woodland sprites hinder enemies caught in a 10 meter radius for 15 seconds — reducing movement by 35% and attack speed by 50%, and causing 3 magic damage per second.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_SummonSkeleton}Raise the Dead
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Raises old bones from the ground to fight for you. Summon 15 Skeleton Warriors.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_GraveCall}Grave Call
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Drawing forth dark energy, the necromancer raises long-dead warriors. Summon 20 Grave Guard.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_NagashGaze}Gaze of Nagash
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A bolt of Dhar flies from the caster's eyes, blackening and withering the flesh it touches to reveal bleached bone beneath. Deals 55 damage on impact.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Shadowblood}Shadowblood
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Shadowy orbs of blood follow the target, staining the ground with every step. Deals 40 damage in a medium area.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Morkharn}Morkharn - Breath of Darkness
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The wizard draws tendrils of the Wind of Death to restore his minions and fill them with unholy vigour. Heals nearby allies over time.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_VanHelsDanseMacabre}Vanhel's Danse Macabre
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The animated dead are given grace and speed, making them all the more deadly. Grants allies +35% attack speed and +15% movement for 60 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_WindOfDeath}Wind of Death
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Invoke the spirits of the dead to consume the souls of the living. Deals medium damage to all in its path as it moves forward.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_CurseOfYears}Curse of Years
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The necromancer utters an ancient curse, causing foes to age at a horrific rate. Reduces enemy attack and movement speed by 50% for 30 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_QuicksilverSwords}Quicksilver Swords
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Infuses the weapons of nearby allies with gleaming energies — even a rusty sword turns deadly. Friendly units deal 20% more damage for 60 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_GleamingArrow}Gleaming Arrow
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Fires a homing projectile of golden energy that seeks the target and deals 100 physical damage.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_MeteroicIronclad}Meteoric Ironclad
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Allies are protected by an enchantment of iron and silver, granting 60% physical resistance for 45 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_PlagueOfRust}Plague of Rust
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The armor of foes in the area is consumed by rust, imposing a 50% physical resistance penalty for 120 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_GehennasGoldenGlobe}Gehenna's Golden Globe
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A glittering globe of golden energy engulfs foes, dealing 75 fire damage in a 5 meter radius. Survivors are slowed by 50% for a short duration.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_FinalTransmutation}Final Transmutation
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The wizard attempts to transmute foes in the area into statues of gold, dealing 4 fire damage per second and slowing them by 90% for 35 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_GehennasGoldenHounds}Gehenna's Golden Hounds
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Calls forth a pair of massive golden hounds that prowl the ground in a circular motion, dealing 40 fire damage per tick in a 3 meter radius for 20 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Apotheosis}Apotheosis
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The wizard infuses allies in the area with pure magical energies, healing 7 health per second for 12 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_CourageOfAenarion}Courage of Aenarion
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Invoking the name of Aenarion, allies around the wizard strike with +30% attack speed for 40 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_SoulQuench}Soul Quench
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A brilliant sphere of light streaks from the wizard's fingertips, dealing 50 holy damage in a 5 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_CurseOfArrowAttraction}Curse of Arrow Attraction
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The air around enemies in the area distorts, guiding allied projectiles — cursed foes take 60% more ranged damage for 10 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_ShieldOfSaphery}Shield of Saphery
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster summons an ethereal dome that shields allies in the area from ranged fire for 45 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_FieryConvocation}Fiery Convocation
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Utter one secret word and your foes burst with fire — 70 fire damage in an 8 meter radius, plus burning damage over time.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Tempest}Tempest
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Conjures a brilliant vortex of shimmering light containing all eight Winds of Magic, dealing 75 magic damage per tick in a 4 meter radius for 8 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_MindControl}Mind Control
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Bend the minds of up to 10 nearby enemies to fight for you. Weaker and wounded foes fall easily while higher level enemies resist. Survivors join your warband after the battle. Success scales off Charm, Leadership, Roguery and Spell Effectiveness.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_Chillwind}Chillwind
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster assails the foe with a freezing gale, dealing 45 magic damage in a 5 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_DoomBolt}Doom Bolt
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The wizard rips open the sky and calls down a bolt burning with dark flames, dealing 325 magic damage in a 17 meter radius.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_DeathSpasm}Death Spasm
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A crackling black bolt of energy that explodes in dark fire, dealing 80 magic damage in a 5 meter radius and setting victims ablaze.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_SoulRain}Soul Rain
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A black cloud looms over the area, striking those below with arcane lightning for 45 magic damage per tick.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_PowerOfDarkness}Power of Darkness
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: The caster draws unstable power from the Realm of Chaos to empower nearby allies, granting +20% physical damage for 35 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_ScreamingSkull}Screaming Skull
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Conjures a screaming skull dripping with acid that flies forward, dealing 60 magic damage per tick to everything in its path.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_BlackHorror}Arnzipal's Black Horror
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: A black cloud of roiling energy sweeps across the battlefield, tentacles lashing out to deal 75 magic damage per tick in a 4 meter radius for 8 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_SoulStealer}Soul Stealer
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Enemies in the area suffer a soul-draining curse, taking 12 magic damage per second for 12 seconds.

AbilityTemplate.Name: {=sotor_spell_ArcaneConduit}Arcane Conduit
AbilityTemplate.TooltipDescription: Channel the Winds of Magic to recharge your own Winds in battle. You are slowed and more vulnerable while channeling; investing in Spellcasting eases the cost and strengthens the flow.
